names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Βιτάλιος», with the rank word left off.

death.note: Stated as a century and never recorded. This folder’s own life says saint.gr has him living as a monk «at the beginning of the seventh century» and falling asleep in peace, and says there is no particular biographical memoir of him; 601–650 is that century, and the century is all that is taken.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
